name: Jwara
definition: Fever. A condition characterized by increased body temperature, blocked sweating, and generalized body ache.

name: Jwara (Pittaja)
definition: Fever caused by aggravation of Pitta dosha, characterized by high temperature and burning sensation.

name: Jwara (Vataja)
definition: Fever caused by aggravation of Vata dosha, accompanied by severe body pain and chills.

name: Jwara (Kaphaja)
definition: Fever caused by aggravation of Kapha dosha, accompanied by heaviness, nausea, and mild temperature.

name: Jwara (Sannipataja)
definition: High fever resulting from simultaneous vitiation of all three doshas.

name: Kasa
definition: Cough. A sudden, forceful hacking sound to release air and clear an irritation in respiratory passage.

name: Kasa (Vataja)
definition: Dry cough with chest pain due to Vata dosha imbalance.

name: Kasa (Pittaja)
definition: Cough accompanied by fever, yellowish sputum, and burning in chest.

name: Kasa (Kaphaja)
definition: Cough with thick white mucus production and loss of appetite.

name: Shwasa
definition: Dyspnea or difficulty in breathing.

name: Tamaka Shwasa

name: Maha Shwasa
definition: Severe respiratory distress with deep guttural breathing sounds.

name: Amlapitta

name: Atisara
definition: Diarrhea or frequent loose watery stools.

name: Pravahika
definition: Dysentery characterized by tenesmus and passage of mucus or blood.

name: Grahani

name: Ajirna
definition: Indigestion or incomplete digestion of food.

name: Chhardi

name: Arshas

name: Kamala

name: Prameha

name: Madhumeha

name: Mutrakrichhra

name: Mutraghata

name: Ashmari
definition: Urolithiasis or renal calculi (kidney stones).

name: Sandhivata

name: Amavata

name: Vatarakta

name: Gridhrasi

name: Katishoola

name: Manya Stambha

name: Avabahuka

name: Kushtha

name: Vicharchika

name: Kitibha

name: Shvitra

name: Dadru

name: Mukhadushika

name: Hridroga

name: Raktapitta

name: Pandu

name: Shotha

name: Unmada

name: Apasmara
definition: Epilepsy or seizure disorder.

name: Anidra

name: Chintadhikyathva

name: Shirashoola

name: Ardhavabhedaka

name: Suryavarta
definition: Frontal sinusitis headache.

name: Netra Abhishyanda
definition: Conjunctivitis or eye inflammation with discharge.

name: Taimira
definition: Cataract or refractive error causing blurred vision.

name: Pitha Suram

name: Khabha Suram
